reviews.author: Usman Ahmed
reviews.title: Team Work
reviews.text: We have had a Service User which had safegaurding concerns. We worked with Bluepits to make a safe and protective environment which gave the Service User a better quality of life. Bluepits were always responsive to emails, calls and open to joint visits. This was a great example of Multi-Agency Working.

reviews.author: Malinda
reviews.title: It has been a pleasure working alongside Blue Pits Housing Action.
reviews.text: On behalf of Cherish UK, we would like to express our sincere appreciation to Nathan, Stephanie and the entire team at Blue Pits Housing Action for their excellent communication, professionalism and continued collaboration.It has been a pleasure working alongside such a dedicated and supportive team. Their person-centred approach, commitment to promoting independence and willingness to work closely with other care providers have contributed to achieving positive outcomes for the individuals we support.We particularly appreciate the excellent communication and teamwork demonstrated by Stephanie and Nathan, which have helped ensure a consistent and coordinated approach to care and support.Thank you once again from everyone at Cherish UK. We truly value our positive working relationship and look forward to continuing our partnership in the future.Cherish UK Rochdale Team

reviews.author: Amaka
reviews.title: Excellent service delivery
reviews.text: I have had a really positive experience working with Blue Pits and have built excellent professional relationships with both the managers and staff. The management team are approachable, proactive, and quick to take action when needed, always keeping the people they support at the centre of their decisions.What I value most is their genuine person-centred approach. The staff clearly know the people they support well and work hard to make sure care is tailored to individual needs and preferences. They are also open to feedback and willing to reflect on their practice, using suggestions to continuously improve the support they provide.From my experience, Blue Pits is a caring, dedicated, and professional service that is committed to achieving positive outcomes for the people they support. It has been a pleasure working alongside such a hardworking and compassionate team.

reviews.author: Jodie Blezard
reviews.title: So grateful for the opportunity to be part of Bluepits!
reviews.text: I would like to share my personal experience from my social work placement at Bluepits. Starting my placement I was always made to feel welcome and well supported within the team. It was more than just somewhere to work it was something meaningful to me, it was enjoyable and will always have a special place in my heart as part of my journey in my career. I found the placement to be incredibly rewarding giving me the opportunity to support individuals in developing and maintaining independent skills and encouraging them to take part in sessions at the landings. I really enjoyed getting involved in the activity classes which included socialising, arts and crafts, games and party’s. I feel I built some lovely relationships whilst also learning and will always be grateful for the experience Bluepits offered me. I have since qualified and moved in to the local authority but feel if the opportunity ever arises in a job change then I would love to return to Bluepits as it’s such a special place that I really do miss.Thank you all at Bluepits for the wonderful experience.

reviews.author: Jill Rhodes
reviews.title: Great support
reviews.text: Everything has worked well. Lewis has settled into his new home. He has grown in confidence and been more outgoing. He has learned how to be organised and is keeping a lovely home to be proud of. His staff have been great with Lewis, motivating him and supporting him to do more. We are so proud of him and thank Bluepits for this
